summary: Reach hosts through a jump host by setting ansible_ssh_common_args with a ProxyCommand (ssh -W) in group_vars; it adds to ssh_args, and older OpenSSH needs nc on the bastion.
questions: How do I connect to servers through a bastion host?
Where should I put ProxyCommand for a group of hosts?

answer_card.title: Use a jump host / bastion
answer_card.answer_md:
In `group_vars/gatewayed.yml`:

```yaml
ansible_ssh_common_args: '-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q user@gateway.example.com"'
```

These args are added to `ssh`/`scp`/`sftp` on top of `ssh_args` from ansible.cfg. `ssh -W` needs OpenSSH 5.4+; with older versions, run `nc %h %p` on the bastion. (`-o ProxyJump=user@gateway` also works with modern OpenSSH.)
